scenes.cap: BILL HWANG ran a private fund called ARCHEGOS.

scenes.say: He borrowed billions from big banks to bet on just a few stocks.
scenes.cap: He BORROWED billions from big banks to bet on just a few stocks.

scenes.say: Then, in March twenty twenty-one, the stocks started to fall.
scenes.cap: Then, in March 2021, the stocks started to FALL.

upload.title: He Lost $20 Billion in 2 Days 📉 #shorts
upload.description:
Bill Hwang's private fund Archegos used borrowed money from big banks to make huge bets on a few stocks. In March 2021 the stocks fell, the banks demanded their money, and about $20 billion vanished in two days. Banks lost over $10 billion (Credit Suisse about $5.5 billion). In 2024 Hwang was convicted of fraud and sentenced to 18 years.
